text: DSH Live 是面向 DSH Web 的手机审批伴侣，提供 iPhone 和 Android 可访问的配对页面。它通过 ApiProxy 订阅待处理审批，并在桌面 WebServer 上提供二维码配对入口；手机可查看工具和原因、批准一次或拒绝，决定经加密会话送回 Host。配对还支持重新生成，插件可配置移动页面和中继地址。适合希望离开电脑时继续处理 agent 审批的 DSH 用户；需要配置 mobileAppUrl 和 relayUrl，并部署可访问的移动页面及 WSS 中继。

DSH Live brings DSH Web approvals to phones. It reads ApiProxy requests and serves QR pairing through the desktop WebServer. A paired phone can review, allow once, or reject; decisions return to the Host over an encrypted session. Configure mobileAppUrl, relayUrl, a mobile page, and a WSS relay.
想离开电脑时，也能在手机上处理 DSH agent 的审批。
有没有办法在手机上查看 agent 正在等待我确认的操作？
让 DSH 把待审批请求发到手机，并允许我批准或拒绝。
我想用二维码把手机和桌面 DSH 配对。
DSH 的 agent 卡在审批等待时，怎么远程给它一个决定？
I want to approve or reject my coding agent’s requests from my phone.
Can I pair a phone with DSH to review pending tool approvals?
我不在电脑旁时，想继续确认 DSH 上的工具请求。
手机查看待审批请求：配对后接收 DSH 的审批事件，并显示工具名称和原因。触发方式是 agent 发起审批；输入为审批事件，页面展示可处理的请求。
手机批准或拒绝：在审批卡片上长按允许一次或点击拒绝，决定通过加密会话发送给 Host，并等待 Host 确认。
二维码配对与重新配对：打开桌面 DSH Live 页面生成手机邀请二维码；页面提供重新生成入口，旧会话关闭后可配对另一部手机。
运行移动审批中继：单独的 relay CLI 启动 WebSocket 服务，供 Host 和手机建立会话；端口及房间限制等运行参数可由环境变量配置。

dsh-live README · Your agent calls. You decide.：> [!IMPORTANT]
> **DSH Live is a source-installable `v0.1.0` preview.** The encrypted phone-approval loop is implemented and maintainer-tested on iPhone and Android. There is no shared public Relay or npm release: deploy a Relay you control and pin installations to a reviewed Git commit or preview tag.

dsh-live README · Stop babysitting your coding agent：Long-running agents should give you time back. Instead, one approval request can leave an agent waiting while you are making coffee, commuting, or reviewing something away from your computer.

DSH Live turns that dead time into a simple mobile loop:

```text
Agent needs you  →  Your phone alerts you  →  You inspect and decide
        ↑                                             ↓
        └──────── Agent continues and reports back ───┘
```
dsh-live README · Stop babysitting your coding agent：It is not a remote terminal and it is not a miniature IDE. It is the focused control surface an agent needs when your attention matters.

dsh-live README · One inbox for decisions：See what the agent wants to do, why approval is required, and the relevant tool context. **Allow once** or **reject** from your phone. Approval remains fail-closed: no connection, malformed response, or expired request can silently grant access.

dsh-live README · Desktop authority stays intact：DSH Live mirrors the official pending approval registry instead of registering a competing approval handler. Desktop and phone can race safely, the first valid decision wins, and a phone or Relay disconnect never grants access or disables desktop approval.

dsh-live README · The Relay carries ciphertext：One-time QR pairing derives directional session keys. Tool names, reasons, and decisions cross the hosted Relay only inside authenticated AES-256-GCM envelopes. The Relay still observes connection metadata; DSH Live does not claim anonymity.
dsh-live README · The first release：Version `v0.1.0-preview.1` deliberately proves one high-value workflow end to end on iPhone and Android.

dsh-live README · The first release：| Capability | `v0.1.0-preview.1` behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Secure pairing | Scan a one-time QR code shown by the DSH plugin |
| Approval inbox | Inspect requests, **allow once**, or **reject** |
| Desktop coexistence | Keep the official desktop approval live; first valid decision wins |
| End-to-end encryption | Keep approval payloads unreadable to the hosted Relay |
| Self-hosted PWA | Serve the phone UI and WSS Relay from one Docker deployment |
| Failure behavior | Disconnect, replay, tampering, and stale decisions fail closed |

dsh-live README · The first release：The preview does **not** include background Push Notification, Live Activity, voice, photos, result review, a terminal, code editor, Git operations, or native App Store/Play Store apps. Keeping this boundary explicit is a product and security decision.

dsh-live README · A typical moment：1. Start a DeepSeek Harness task on your computer.
2. Scan the DSH Live pairing QR code with your phone.
3. Keep the paired PWA open while the agent works.
4. Inspect an approval request when it appears on the phone.
5. Hold **Allow once** to approve the exact action, or tap **Reject**.
6. Continue on desktop; either surface may resolve the next approval.

dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhoushuoshi-code/dsh-live#v0.1.0-preview.1

The repository commits prebuilt JavaScript and a standard DSH bundle manifest. The CI workflow also produces an installable tarball artifact. An npm release remains a later, separately verified distribution step.

dsh-live README · Target requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.7` (the first compatibility target)
- Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0`, matching DeepSeek Harness
- pnpm available on `PATH`, as required by `dsh plugin`

Compatibility will be widened only after it is tested—not assumed.

dsh-live README · How it works：```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[DeepSeek Harness] -->|local plugin events| B[DSH Live host plugin]
    B -->|encrypted outbound WSS| C[Blind relay]
    C -->|encrypted session| D[Mobile PWA]

dsh-live README · How it works：The desktop plugin initiates the outbound connection, so the user does not expose a local port to the public internet. The relay transports encrypted envelopes and has no access to prompts, commands, images, results, pairing secrets, or API keys. It necessarily observes routing and traffic metadata. See the [versioned E2EE protocol and threat model](docs/e2ee-protocol.md).

DSH Live uses DeepSeek Harness's official extension seams:

dsh-live README · How it works：- [`approval/request`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/subsystems/approval.md) for one-shot, fail-closed decisions
- Profile plugin bundles for installation into the `web` profile

No DOM scraping, UI monkey-patching, or dependency on private in-memory objects is planned.

dsh-live README · Approval bridge: verified：The first technical spike passed against DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.7`. DSH Live consumes the public `ctx.apiProxy` service as a second client; it does not register or steal an `approval/request` answerer. Desktop and mobile receive the same stable pending request, the first valid response wins, mobile disconnect leaves desktop approval live, and turn cancellation closes both views. See the [reproducible spike report](docs/approval-bridge-spike.md).

dsh-live README · Security model：Remote approval is a security boundary, not just a notification feature. The preview implements and tests these guarantees:

Implemented guarantees:

dsh-live README · Security model：- **Allow once only.** The phone cannot create a permanent approval rule.
- **Fail closed.** Disconnects, timeouts, cancellation, invalid messages, and missing handlers never become approval.
- **First valid decision wins.** Desktop and mobile can race safely; an action executes at most once.
- **End-to-end encrypted payloads.** Pairing establishes session keys; the relay should only see routing metadata and ciphertext.
- **Replay resistance.** Every command carries a session identity, sequence number, expiry, and authenticated encryption tag.
- **No API keys on the phone.** DeepSeek credentials remain with the Harness host.
- **Desktop remains authoritative.** Losing the phone or relay must not disable local approval or task control.
dsh-live README · Security model：See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for private vulnerability reporting and [the protocol document](docs/e2ee-protocol.md) for the exact metadata boundary.
dsh-live README · Platform support：The maintainer reports completing the approval journey on both phone families. Exact device/browser versions should still be included in bug reports:

dsh-live README · Platform support：| Platform | Supported path | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| iPhone | Current Safari · direct QR link | Keep the PWA foregrounded; no background Push yet |
| Android | Current Chrome · direct QR link | Keep the PWA foregrounded; no background Push yet |
| Desktop host | DeepSeek Harness Web profile | Initial target: DSH `0.1.0-rc.7` |
| Embedded browsers | Not supported | Open the pairing link in Safari or Chrome |
dsh-live README · Platform support：If notifications are unavailable, an open PWA must still receive live updates. If the phone is offline, desktop DeepSeek Harness must continue to work normally.

section: Release gates for the approval preview

text:
dsh-live README · Release gates for the approval preview：1. Desktop and phone see the same pending approval.
2. A phone approval executes the requested tool no more than once.
3. A desktop decision resolves the phone card immediately.
4. Phone or relay disconnection never breaks desktop approval.
5. Turn cancellation withdraws the mobile request.
6. The installable tarball contains the plugin, PWA, Relay, and deployment docs.
7. The critical journey passes on a real iPhone and Android device.

text: dsh-live README · Contributing：DSH Live is being built in public. Early contributions are most valuable when they improve the approval bridge, protocol security, cross-platform PWA behavior, accessibility, or reproducible installation. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

dsh-live README · Contributing：Before opening a large pull request, please start with an issue describing the user problem, security implications, and proposed acceptance test. Bug reports should include the DeepSeek Harness version, host OS, phone/browser version, reproduction steps, and expected versus actual behavior—without secrets or private prompts.
